environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Quarkus native compiled) deployed in a VPC with standard NAT gateway for internet access. The Lambda execution role has s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on the UPLOAD_BUCKET. Lambda uses /tmp with 10GB ephemeral storage. Multiple concurrent invocations share the same execution environment when warm. No S3 VPC endpoint configured - traffic routes through NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint. The UPLOAD_BUCKET has no bucket policy restrictions beyond the Lambda role's IAM permissions.
